title: 272. Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array II

examples.explanation: The first 5 entries become [1,1,2,2,3]; one extra 1 is dropped.
The first 7 entries become [0,0,1,1,2,3,3]; two extra 1s are dropped.

hints: Because the array is sorted, compare each candidate with the element two positions before the write pointer.
Keep nums[i] when it differs from nums[k-2]; otherwise it would be a third copy.
Short arrays (length <= 2) are already valid and need no changes.
